public int emptyObjects = 0; public int gcConcatIterations = 1000; public int gcArrayAllocs = 0; public int overdrawLayers = 0; public Material overdrawMaterial; [Range(0, 2000)] public int prepopulateCount = 0; private MaterialPropertyBlock propBlock; private static readonly int ColorProp = Shader.PropertyToID(\"_Color\"); private ObjectPool<GameObject> pool; private readonly List<GameObject> activeObjects = new List<GameObject>(); private readonly StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(4096); private GameObject[] cachedSceneObjects; private void Awake() { propBlock = new MaterialPropertyBlock(); if (testPrefab != null) { pool = new ObjectPool<GameObject>(() => Instantiate(testPrefab), go => go.SetActive(true), go => go.SetActive(false), go => Destroy(go), false, 100, 2000); } } private void Start() { if (prepopulateCount > 0 && pool != null) { for (int i = 0; i < prepopulateCount; i++) SpawnOne(); } for (int i = 0; i < emptyObjects; i++) new GameObject(\"Empty_\" + i); if (overdrawLayers > 0 && overdrawMaterial != null) BuildOverdrawLayers(); quad.name = \"Overdraw_\" + i; quad.transform.SetParent(cam.transform, false); quad.transform.localPosition = new Vector3(0f, 0f, d); quad.transform.localScale = new Vector3(h * cam.aspect, h, 1f); quad.GetComponent<Renderer>().sharedMaterial = overdrawMaterial; } } private void Update() { if (stressGc) { sb.Clear(); for (int i = 0; i < gcConcatIterations; i++) sb.Append(i); } if (stressCpu) { if (cachedSceneObjects == null) cachedSceneObjects = FindObjectsOfType<GameObject>(); } if (stressDraw && pool != null) { int n = Mathf.Max(1, cubesPerFrame); for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) SpawnOne(); } } private void SpawnOne() { if (pool == null) return; var clone = pool.Get(); clone.transform.position = UnityEngine.Random.insideUnitSphere * spawnRadius; rend.SetPropertyBlock(propBlock); } } } } }","explicacao_didatica":"Em C#, somar textos usando o operador '+' cria uma nova copia na memoria toda vez.
